texts.en: Arrogant little wretch! Did you think that the [Root.GetSpeciesName] colonists sullying our holy places would go unnoticed? Leave our worlds immediately or face the might of our fleets!

texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName], we have observed your fumbling attempts at creating artificial intelligence and come to the conclusion that you are headed down the path of spiritual self-destruction. Abandon this foolish endeavour at once, or we will MAKE you.

texts.en: [Root.GetSpeciesName] barbarians! Your crimes have not gone unnoticed. The enslavement and butchery that you are so wantonly engaging threatens the future of the entire galaxy. We present you with a choice: end your barbarous practices, or prepare to face our righteous might.

texts.zh: 无知的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们对长者的不敬简直大错特错。匍匐在我们面前乞求宽恕，我们或许有可能放过你们那毫无价值的小帝国。
texts.en: Foolish [Root.GetSpeciesName]. The lack of respect you show for your elders will be your undoing. Prostrate yourselves before us and beg our forgiveness, and we may refrain from annihilating your worthless little empire.

texts.zh: 不和谐的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。难道你们没有发现自己是在带来杂音逼我们动手吗。好自为之，不然我们会来帮你们调调音准的。
texts.en: Disharmonious [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Don't you see that by inviting chaos you force us to intervene. Harmonize now or we will tune you.

texts.zh: 愚昧的[Root.GetSpeciesName]，你们拒绝成长演化就是对生命本身的亵渎。乖乖听话，否则我们会把你们连根拔起，反正我们再种下新的种子亦非难事。
texts.en: Stagnant [Root.GetSpeciesName], your refusal to grow and evolve is an affront to life itself. Embrace our teachings, or we will uproot your failure and sow the seeds of progress ourselves

texts.zh: 怯懦的[Root.GetSpeciesName]。你们的帝国就是脆弱的教科书。把你们的弱点咽下去，好好道歉，然后准备接受我们的挑战——否则我们可以随手把你们化为齑粉，用更有价值的人来替代你们。
texts.en: Cowardly [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Your empire is a testament to frailty. Now swallow your weakness, apologize, and get ready to meet our challenge - or we will shatter you and replace you with someone more worthy.

# 失落帝国行为 / Fallen Empire Behavior

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources：`events/game_start.txt:1706-1722`、`common/situations/03_AI_empire_situations.txt:618-660`、`events/fallen_empire_events.txt:90-190`、`events/fallen_empire_events.txt:190-450` · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

开局时 game_start.10（events/game_start.txt:1706-1722）给每个失落帝国启动一个玩家看不到的情境 fallen_empires_situation，用来处理每月的随机事件。

At game start game_start.10 (events/game_start.txt:1706-1722) starts an invisible situation, fallen_empires_situation, on each Fallen Empire to drive its monthly random events.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

情境每月（on_monthly）在 fallen_empires.1/.3/.10/.11 四个隐藏事件中按50/50/15/50抽一个（03_AI_empire_situations.txt:632-638）：.1 补充舰队；.3 发出警告；.10 建立联系（调用 action.1，属 event-action-1）；.11 补充建设舰。只有 .3 会产生可见的窗口：当失落帝国未参战、本年未发过警告、舰队战力>100000，且有一个已建立通讯、且失落帝国对其意见<-99的普通国家时，它向该国发出 4–8 中的一个“来自失落帝国的通讯”，并设置 fe_demand_made 旗标。

Each month (on_monthly) the situation draws one of four hidden events, fallen_empires.1/.3/.10/.11 with weights 50/50/15/50 (03_AI_empire_situations.txt:632-638): .1 refills the fleet, .3 sends a warning, .10 establishes contact (calls action.1, another story) and .11 gives a construction ship. Only .3 yields a visible window: if the Fallen Empire is at peace, has not warned in the last 360 days, has fleet power over 100000 and a contacted ordinary empire is held in opinion below -99 by it, it sends that empire one of 4-8 and sets fe_demand_made.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

4–8 是顺序匹配的互斥分支（见上）。每个窗口两选项：接受（执行要求并被羞辱）或拒绝（对方意见惩罚，旗标清除）；AI接受概率90%，若对方舰队战力>300000则不会接受。

4-8 are exclusive, matched in order (see above). Each window offers accept (carry out the demand and be humiliated) or refuse (opinion penalty); the AI accepts with weight 90 vs 10, never when its fleet power exceeds 300000.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

各警告的触发条件见“剧情脉络”。

The conditions for each warning are listed above.

- 编译器曾把 4–8 显示为各30%概率的并列随机项；已更正为顺序匹配。
  The compiler showed 4-8 as parallel 30% random entries; corrected to ordered matching.
